title: Hari Krishna Mandir Trust v. State of Maharashtra

content.caseIdentity: Hari Krishna Mandir Trust v. State of Maharashtra, (2020) 9 SCC 356
content.holding: The right to property under Article 300A is an integral part of human rights; the State cannot usurp private roads or trust land without enacting statutory acquisition.
content.relevance: Reaffirmation of property as a human right.
